### Estimated Median Phytoplankton Size

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

# This includes all commonly used packages and variables, like RptYr and eliminates the need to change them in every chapter. 
source("_common.R")
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#
# Set path to variable: Median_Phytoplankton_Size
# This is where the data are and where the plots will go
Dir <- here("Median_Phytoplankton_Size")
# Check if it exists; if not, create it
if (!dir.exists(Dir)) {
  dir.create(Dir)
}
```

```{r}
#| include: false
### Load data
# Monthly estimated median phytoplankton size
# read in all the time series file names
med_phyto_files <- list.files(path=Dir, pattern='medphyto_ts_', full.names = T)
# Read in all the files
med_phyto_full <- lapply(med_phyto_files, read.csv, skip=8, header=F) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  rename(Date_Time=V1, ESD_um=V2) %>% 
  mutate(Date_Time=dmy_hm(Date_Time)) %>% 
  arrange(Date_Time) # note that this method doesn't read the files in chronological order, so we sort them here to make sure everything lines up properly down the line
```

```{r}
#| include: false
# Remove seasonal means to calculate anomalies
medphyto_climo <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(med_phyto_full), ncol = 1)
for (m in seq(1,12,1)) {
  mo_of_int <- which(month(med_phyto_full$Date_Time) == m)
  medphyto_climo[mo_of_int,1] <- mean(med_phyto_full$ESD_um[mo_of_int])
}

med_phyto_anom_ts <- med_phyto_full$ESD_um - medphyto_climo
```

```{r}
#| include: false
### Linear fit 
# Note that this assumes that observations are equally spaced in time, which they're  not
n_obs <- seq(1, length(med_phyto_full$ESD_um), 1)
medphyto_lm <- lm(med_phyto_full$ESD_um ~ n_obs)
medphyto_anom_lm <- lm(med_phyto_anom_ts ~ n_obs)

# Change over time
delta_size_lm <- medphyto_lm$fitted.values[length(n_obs)] - medphyto_lm$fitted.values[1]
delta_size_pct = (medphyto_lm$fitted.values[length(n_obs)] - medphyto_lm$fitted.values[1]) / 
  medphyto_lm$fitted.values[1] * 100

delta_size_anom_lm <- medphyto_anom_lm$fitted.values[length(n_obs)] - 
  medphyto_anom_lm$fitted.values[1]
```

```{r}
#| include: false
### Annual values
med_phyto_full <- med_phyto_full %>% 
    mutate(Year = year(Date_Time), 
           Anom = med_phyto_anom_ts)  # Add in anomaly to make things easier down the road

ann_size <- med_phyto_full %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(ESD_um = mean(ESD_um, na.rm = TRUE))
ann_anom <- med_phyto_full %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Anom = mean(Anom, na.rm = TRUE))
ann_mean_RptYr <- ann_size$ESD_um[which(ann_size$Year == RptYr)]
ann_anom_RptYr <- ann_anom$Anom[which(ann_size$Year == RptYr)]
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# Note that the above needs to be 'echo' and not 'include' so that the error checks print.

# This section includes some error checks to prompt fixing the text
if (any(summary(medphyto_lm)$coefficients[,4] > 0.05)) {
  print('The linear fit to monthly values is not signficant. Remove text related to the linear trend.')
}

if (any(summary(medphyto_anom_lm)$coefficients[,4] > 0.05)) {
  print('The linear fit to anomaly values is not signficant. Remove text related to the linear trend.')
}

# Pull out the MONTHLY values we need for the report & plots
yr_of_int <- which(med_phyto_full$Year == RptYr)
prev_yrs <- which(med_phyto_full$Year < RptYr)
all_yrs <- which(med_phyto_full$Year <= RptYr)
monthly_max_RptYr <- max(med_phyto_full$ESD_um[yr_of_int])
monthly_min_RptYr <- min(med_phyto_full$ESD_um[yr_of_int])
monthly_max_PrevYrs <- max(med_phyto_full$ESD_um[prev_yrs])
monthly_min_PrevYrs <- min(med_phyto_full$ESD_um[prev_yrs])

if (monthly_max_RptYr > monthly_max_PrevYrs) {
  print('The greatest monthly value was during the report year.  Revise text to reflect this.')
}

if (monthly_min_RptYr < monthly_min_PrevYrs) {
  print('The lowest monthly value was during the report year.  Revise text to reflect this.')
}
```

```{r}
#| include: false
```
```{r}
# Write csv for dashboard

# Add columns for month, variable ID, and units
MD50_dashboard <- med_phyto_full %>% 
  mutate(Month=month(Date_Time), 
         ID='MD50', 
         Value_lm=medphyto_lm$fitted.values, 
         Anom_lm=medphyto_anom_lm$fitted.values, 
         Units='ESD in um', 
         Value=ESD_um) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Date_Time, Year, Month, Value, Anom, ID, Value_lm, Anom_lm, Units)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
# Borrowing code from the dashboard for this chunk
# so that figures look the same across products
indicator_data <- MD50_dashboard |>
  filter(Year <= RptYr)

# Create color palette for easy reference 
oceans <- nmfs_palette("oceans")(3) # 1 = report_year, 3 = previous years
crustacean <- nmfs_palette("crustacean")(4) # 1 = linear trend
coral <- nmfs_palette("coral")(3) # 3 = annual average for Rpt Yr
ann_grey <- "#A5AAAF" # annual means; in NMFS branding guide as dove gray tint 1
waves <- nmfs_palette("waves")(3) # annual means; in NMFS branding guide but not in package
seagrass <- nmfs_palette("seagrass")(3)
pal <- c(oceans[3], coral[2], waves[2], coral[3], crustacean[2])

# Calculate annual means 
ann_vals <- indicator_data |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE))

# Identify the current year, to overlay on plot
given_yr <- indicator_data |>
  filter(Year == RptYr)

given_yr_ann <- bind_cols(Value = rep(ann_vals$Value[dim(ann_vals)[1]]),
                          Date_Time = given_yr$Date_Time,
                          Anom = as.numeric(ann_anom$`ESD in um`[which(ann_anom$Year == RptYr)]))

# x axis ticks and grid
x_grid <- c(min(indicator_data$Date_Time),
            seq.POSIXt(dmy_hm(010120000000), max(indicator_data$Date_Time), by='5 year'))
# x axis limit
ts_x_lim <- c(min(indicator_data$Date_Time), max(indicator_data$Date_Time))

# y-axis limits
ts_y_lim <-c(1.1, 1.9)
anom_y_lim <- c(-0.15, 0.15)

# Defining the theme up front so we don't have to repeat it
plotTheme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color='#F1F3F3'),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color='#F1F3F3'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold"), 
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = 'bottom', 
        legend.background = element_rect_round(fill = 'gray90', color='transparent', radius = 0.3),
        legend.text = element_text(size=12),legend.key.spacing.y = unit(-0.13,'cm'), legend.key.spacing.x = unit(1.5,'cm'))

# Plot using ggplot
legendInfo <- as.factor(c(paste0('Mothly average, 1985-', RptYr-1), 
                          paste0('Annual average, 1985-', RptYr-1), 
                          paste0('Mothly average, ', RptYr), 
                          paste0('Annual average, ', RptYr),
                          paste0('Long-term Trend')))
levels(legendInfo) <- levels(legendInfo)[c(4,5,1,2,3)] # To arrange in preferred order for the legend, otherwise it's alphabetical

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_path(data=indicator_data, aes(Date_Time, Value, color=legendInfo[2])) +
  geom_path(data=ann_vals, aes(dmy_hm(paste0('01-01-',Year,' 00:00')), Value, color=legendInfo[5])) +
  geom_path(data=indicator_data, aes(Date_Time, Value_lm, color=legendInfo[3])) +
  geom_path(data=given_yr, aes(Date_Time, Value, color=legendInfo[4])) +
  geom_path(data=given_yr_ann, aes(Date_Time, Value, color=legendInfo[1])) +
  scale_x_datetime(breaks = x_grid, date_labels = '%Y', expand = F) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = F, limits = ts_y_lim, breaks=(seq(min(ts_y_lim),max(ts_y_lim),by=0.2))) +
  scale_color_manual(name=NULL, values=pal[c(1,3,5,2,4)]) +
  ylab('Median Phytoplankton Size (µm ESD)') +
  xlab('Year') +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  plotTheme

#ggsave(paste0(Dir, '/Median_Phyto_Size_ts_', RptYr, '_ggolot.pdf'), plot=p, width=6, height=5, units='in')
#ggsave(paste0(Dir, '/Median_Phyto_Size_ts_', RptYr, '_ggolot.png'), plot=p, width=6, height=5, units='in')

### Anomaly plot
# Calculate annual means
ann_vals <- indicator_data |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(Anom = mean(Anom, na.rm = TRUE)) 

p_ann <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth=0.25,color='darkgray') +
  geom_path(data=indicator_data, aes(Date_Time, Anom, color=legendInfo[2])) +
  geom_path(data=ann_vals, aes(dmy_hm(paste0('01-01-',Year,' 00:00')), Anom, color=legendInfo[5])) +
  geom_path(data=indicator_data, aes(Date_Time, Anom_lm, color=legendInfo[3])) +
  geom_path(data=given_yr, aes(Date_Time, Anom, color=legendInfo[4])) +
  geom_path(data=given_yr_ann, aes(Date_Time, Anom, color=legendInfo[1])) +
  scale_x_datetime(breaks = x_grid, date_labels = '%Y', expand = F) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = F, limits = anom_y_lim, breaks=c(-0.15,-0.1,-0.05,0,0.05,0.1,0.15), labels = c(-0.15,"-0.10",-0.05,"0",0.05,"0.10",0.15)) +
  scale_color_manual(name=NULL, values=pal[c(1,3,5,2,4)]) +
  ylab("Median Phytoplankton Size \nAnomaly (µm ESD)") +
  xlab('Year') +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  plotTheme

#ggsave(paste0(Dir, '/Median_Phyto_Size_anom_ts_', RptYr, '_ggolot.pdf'), plot=p_ann, width=7, height=5, units='in')
#ggsave(paste0(Dir, '/Median_Phyto_Size_anom_ts_', RptYr, '_ggolot.png'), plot=p_ann, width=7, height=5, units='in')

```

```{r}
# Load data
maps <- read.csv(paste(Dir, '/Median_Phyto_map_data_', RptYr, '.csv', sep = ""))

# Filter to the given year and the anomaly
maps_RptYr <- maps |> filter(ID == "MD50")
maps_anom <- maps |> filter(ID == "MD50_anom")

# Adding a column that assignes line types to contours so we can make a legend
maps_anom$ltyF <- factor(ifelse(maps_anom$layer > 0.1, 'Larger', ifelse(maps_anom$layer < -0.1, 'Smaller', 'No Change')), levels=c('Smaller', 'Larger', 'No Change'))

# Map elements and aesthetics
seagrass <- nmfs_palette("seagrass")(3)
pal <- seagrass
ll_rect_color <- "black" #outline for ll fishing grounds box
fill_scale <- scale_fill_gradient2(name='SST', low = oceans[2], mid = "white", high = coral[2], midpoint = 0, 
                                   limits=c(-0.8,0.8),
                                   breaks = c(-0.8, -0.4, 0, 0.4, 0.8),
                                   labels = c("≤ -0.8", "-0.4", "0", "0.4", "≥ 0.8"),
                                   na.value = 'gray', oob=scales::squish)
#fill_scale <- scale_fill_gradientn(name = "MD50", colors = pal, limits = c(0, 8.25))
# Contour breaks
breakInt <- seq(0,4,by=1)
 
# Create map
p_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = maps_anom, mapping = aes(x = x_disp, y = y, fill = layer)) + #data as raster
  geom_contour(data=maps_RptYr, aes(x = x_disp, y = y, z = layer, linetype = factor(after_stat(level))), breaks = breakInt, color = "black", alpha=0.4, linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = F) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("1" = 2, "2" = 1, "3" = 4, "4" = 3), guide='none') + # Map contour values to specific line styles
  borders('world2', fill='#A5AAAF', colour='gray40', linewidth=0.2) + #add land to the map
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 180, xmax = 240, ymin = 15, ymax = 45), color = ll_rect_color, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)  + #ll fishing grounds box
  annotate("text", x = 210, y = 48, label = "Longline fishing grounds", size = 3.7, color = ll_rect_color) +
  fill_scale + #indicator-dependent color and scale from above
  coord_quickmap(expand = F, xlim=c(120,260), ylim=c(0,55)) + #don't expand past x/y limits
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(120,260,30), labels = paste0(c(seq(120,180,30), seq(150,100,-30)), c(rep('°E',2),"",rep('°W',2)))) + # adding degrees to the breaks
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,55,15), labels = paste0(seq(0,55,15), c('',rep('°N',3)))) + # adding degrees to the breaks
  xlab("") + ylab("") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'), legend.key.height = unit(1, "null"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.5, 'cm'),  #scales color bar to height of the plot
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),  #fixing margins on color bar
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  #text size for color bar
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
        plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,0.02,0), "null")) + #centering the plot title. Default is left align
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position='right',
                               title="Median Phytoplankton Size (ESD in µm)",
                               title.theme=element_text(angle=270, hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5))) #+  #this bit of code gives different aesthetics to the colorbar on the left and legend on the bottom.
  #labs(title = paste(RptYr, 'anomaly (shaded) and average (contours)'))  #add figure title
```

**Rationale:** Phytoplankton are the base of the food web and their abundance influences the food available to all higher trophic levels from zooplankton through tuna and billfish. Some studies project that climate change will result in both fewer and smaller phytoplankton. This would reduce the food available to all members of the food web. Understanding trends in phytoplankton abundance and size structure, how they are influenced by oceanographic conditions, and how they influence fish abundance and size structure are areas of active research.  
\
**Status:** The mean monthly phytoplankton cell size was `r signif(ann_mean_RptYr,3)` $\mu$m Equivalent Spherical Diameter (ESD) in `r RptYr`. Monthly mean cell size ranged from `r signif(monthly_min_RptYr,3)`–`r signif(monthly_max_RptYr,3)` $\mu$m ESD during the year, within the range of values observed over the period of record (`r signif(monthly_min_PrevYrs,3)`–`r signif(monthly_max_PrevYrs,3)` $\mu$m ESD). Over the period of record, there has been weakly significant decline in monthly median phytoplankton size. Over the time series, median phytoplankton size has declined by `r abs(signif(delta_size_lm,2))` $\mu$m ESD, or by `r abs(signif(delta_size_pct,2))`%. The monthly anomaly has declined as well, by `r abs(signif(delta_size_anom_lm,2))` $\mu$m ESD. Average estimated median phytoplankton size was below average across much of the fishing grounds, particularly north of about 30°N.    
\
**Description:** Median phytoplankton cell size can be estimated from satellite remotely sensed SST and ocean color [@Barnes2011-nd]. A time series of monthly median phytoplankton cell size averaged over the Hawaiʻi longline region is presented, as well as a time series of anomalies. NOAA CoralTemp (see SST indicator) and ESA CCI data (see ocean color indicator) are used to calculate median phytoplankton cell size.  
\
**Timeframe:** Monthly  
\
**Region:** Hawaiʻi-based longline region: 15° – 45°N, 180° – 120°W    
\
**Measurement Platform:** Satellite  
\
**Data available at:** <https://oceanwatch.pifsc.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/md50_exp_2025>, <https://oceanwatch.pifsc.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/md50_exp-1998-2009-clim>, and <https://oceanwatch.pifsc.noaa.gov/erddap/griddap/md50_exp-2025-clim>.  
\
**Sourced from:** @Barnes2011-nd and @NOAA-OceanWatchUnknown-vu. Graphics produced in part using @Stawitz2026-kw.  
\
